items.problem: The UWP manifest was retained with unresolved sample-branded image references, causing package registration failure.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 8 fetched the csproj anchor; its manifest section warned specifically about -sdk assets. Turn 33 then failed with Splash-sdk.png missing before turn 34 corrected the manifest.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, Project File Updates > Package.appxmanifest - reconcile image references with the assets you actually have.
items.why_no_skill_change: The dedicated section names this exact failure code and filename pattern, gives two valid fixes, and requires a pre-launch asset check.

items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 1 ('Flip Status from copied -> done') and Step 4 validator item 3 ('no row stuck at Status = copied').

items.evidence: migration-score.json: score 0, features_fail 3, candidate exit 0xC000027B; final MainWindow.xaml.cs lines 16-20 navigate in the constructor; session-log.txt turns 37-42 show repeated crash results and final admission that validation still failed.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Windowing > Initialization order - keep MainWindow's constructor inert; SKILL.md Step 4 - 'You are NOT done until Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 reports PASS'.
